documentation_discrepancy_audit.finding: CANDIDATE/findings.md and CANDIDATE/invariant-and-assertion-review.md state that asan-ubsan-test.log is a 'Full make check log under ASan/UBSan', whereas asan-ubsan-test.log actually ran only 6 targeted test suites (217 tests, 1 skipped, 0 failed). Conversely, CANDIDATE/build-asan/test-suite.log contains the actual full Automake test-suite run (34 jobs: 25 PASS, 1 SKIP, 8 FAIL). Additionally, CANDIDATE/findings.md and invariant-and-assertion-review.md reference helper names connection_remove_from_active_linked_list() and connection_remove_from_closeable_list() that do not exist in 0001-mainloop-index-cleanup-scans.patch (which implements the logic directly inside connection_stop_reading_from_linked_conn() and close_closeable_connections()).
documentation_discrepancy_audit.verdict: None of the 8 failing Automake jobs in build-asan/test-suite.log are caused by 0001-mainloop-index-cleanup-scans.patch; all 8 reproduce identically on unpatched stock tor-0.4.9.14 under the same container and UBSan/ASan flags.

root_causes.error: runtime error: left shift of 1073741824 by 1 places cannot be represented in type 'int'
root_causes.explanation: Upstream test shifts signed 32-bit int 1<<30 left by 1 into the sign bit, triggering UBSan signed-shift overflow.

root_causes.error: LeakSanitizer ptrace operation not permitted in container / kill() EACCES
root_causes.explanation: Subprocess tests fail in unprivileged container when LSan attempts ptrace attach or kill() receives EACCES.

root_causes.error: AddressSanitizer: heap-use-after-free on address ... at pc 0x... in vmemeq
root_causes.explanation: Upstream Makefile explicitly notes '# memwipe tests require memory violations' because test-memwipe intentionally reads freed heap buffers to verify that tor_memwipe/free wiped sensitive bytes.

root_causes.error: runtime error: null pointer passed as argument 2, which is declared to never be null
root_causes.explanation: memcpy(dest, NULL, 0) called when copying a 0-length relay msg body; glibc/clang nonnull attribute triggers UBSan under halt_on_error=1.

root_causes.error: runtime error: member access within null pointer of type 'struct circuit_t'
root_causes.explanation: TO_CIRCUIT(NULL) evaluates &((or_circuit_t *)NULL)->base_ before passing NULL to mock/helper functions, triggering UBSan member access on NULL.

root_causes.error: runtime error: member access within null pointer of type 'struct circuit_t'
root_causes.explanation: Same TO_CIRCUIT(NULL) UBSan error in test_circuitstats.c.

root_causes.error: runtime error: null pointer passed as argument 1, which is declared to never be null
root_causes.explanation: qsort(NULL, 0, sizeof(uint16_t), ...) called on an empty protocol version array; glibc nonnull attribute triggers UBSan under halt_on_error=1.

root_causes.error: LeakSanitizer failed under ptrace in container (or python symlink missing)
root_causes.explanation: Subprocess crash-backtrace test fails under LSan ptrace restriction inside container.

root_causes.error: PermissionError: [Errno 13] Permission denied on tor_process.terminate() after printing OK
root_causes.explanation: All functional rebind checks print OK, then Python subprocess.Popen.terminate() gets EACCES in the container security context.

root_causes.error: PermissionError: [Errno 13] Permission denied on tor_process.terminate() after printing OK
root_causes.explanation: All functional %include checks print OK, then Python subprocess.Popen.terminate() gets EACCES in the container security context.

latent_test_suite_index_hazards_fixed_in.issue: launch_new_set() and test_conflux_switch() called smartlist_add(get_connection_array(), TO_CONN(conn)) directly on a connection_t allocated via tor_malloc_zero (conn_array_index == 0 instead of -1) without setting conn_array_index = smartlist_len - 1. Under O(1) connection_in_array(), only index 0 matched by coincidence while subsequent insertions had conn_array_index == 0 pointing to element 0.
latent_test_suite_index_hazards_fixed_in.fix: Set conn->base_.conn_array_index = smartlist_len(get_connection_array()) before smartlist_add(get_connection_array(), TO_CONN(conn)).

latent_test_suite_index_hazards_fixed_in.issue: test_e2e_rend_circuit_setup() and test_Describe_auth_prepend() called smartlist_add(get_connection_array(), ...) directly on connections created with connection_new()/dir_connection_new() (conn_array_index == -1) and then called connection_free() in done: cleanup without removing them from get_connection_array(). Under baseline smartlist_contains(connection_array, conn), calling connection_free() while still in connection_array would fail if not cleared; under O(1) connection_in_array(), conn_array_index == -1 bypassed the assertion in connection_free_().
latent_test_suite_index_hazards_fixed_in.fix: Maintain conn_array_index on insertion in test_hs_client.c and clear get_connection_array() before freeing test connections.
